purpose: Independent voicings, never an averaged spring target. Recordings are analysis inputs, not runtime convolution assets.

references.role: primary Grampian geometry and voicing target
references.provenance: Local filename identifies Grampian; exact hardware, drive level, capture procedure and redistribution license not independently established.
references.preparation: Decode to float mono at analysis rate; preserve capture start and fast HF precursor. No peak trim, click excision, or peak normalization. Normalize analysis energy only.
references.timing: First LF packets near 16 and 24 ms; repeat packets near 77 and 100 ms. Capture/interface latency has not been independently measured.
references.noise: Estimate stationary per-band power from final 300 ms of the analysis window, subtract before integration, score decay only above -30 dB and before 2 s. Inspect curves; this is not a calibrated noise measurement.

references.role: separate filtered tonal cross-check; not optimized or averaged
references.provenance: Local filename only; likely related capture, not an independent tank. Aligned first-2-second waveform correlation approximately 0.922 with primary.
references.preparation: Same float decode as primary. Keep its original timing; roughly 2.4 ms later than primary. Both files are effectively mono.

other_families.caution: 90.7% raw energy in first 10 ms; direct speaker response must be separated before fitting a wet-only tank.

other_families.role: short amp-spring and EQ cross-checks, not independent tanks
other_families.caution: 18 variants, each 0.966 s; 98.7–99.5% raw energy in first 10 ms. Do not estimate long spring decay from these files or fit the dry click.

other_families.role: legacy derivatives excluded from Grampian v2 identification
other_families.caution: Peak trimming changes propagation timing and 16-bit conversion discards original precision.
